## Findings

None. Every requirement produces a row, reaches a NEED, names an executed case, and — where Test-verified — names a red case; every one of the 11 CONOPS identifiers is cited.

**This clean result is not by itself evidence the checks work.** Every failure condition above has zero naturally occurring instances in this record, so a generator with all of them stubbed would print this same section. What makes it evidence is `--self-test`, which demonstrates each condition failing generation on a synthesized input, and which runs in the gate.

## Conditions enforced

| # | Condition |
|---|---|
| F0 | every requirement produces a matrix row |
| F1 | every requirement reaches a NEED, directly or by an acyclic parent chain |
| F2 | every requirement has a downstream verification reference |
| F3 | every NEED/CON/ASM defined in the CONOPS is cited by some requirement |
| F4 | every parent cited in a trace cell is a requirement in the spine |
| F5 | every row names an EXECUTED case (owner's addition; a blank is a finding) |
| F6 | every Test-verified requirement has a demonstrated RED case (HUG-VER-002/B4) |

Struck in place: `HUG-SYS-006` (D-019). A struck requirement keeps its row and its cases and is exempt from F1, F2, F5 and F6. It covers no CONOPS identifier, and no other requirement reaches a NEED through it.
